overview: Lithuania is the largest and southernmost of the three Baltic states. Its capital is Vilnius. In the Middle Ages, the Grand Duchy of Lithuania was one of the largest countries in Europe. In 1990 Lithuania became the first Soviet republic to declare independence, and it joined NATO and the European Union in 2004.

geography.text: Lithuania is mostly flat, with low hills, many lakes and forests, and the long Neman river. Its short Baltic coast includes part of the Curonian Spit, a narrow strip of sand dunes it shares with Russia's Kaliningrad region. Even the highest point in the country is only about 300 metres above sea level.
